each <span class="file-note-marker" title="note marker"></span> in the code opens a note on that line. [download widgets.yaml](../files/swarm/homepage/config/widgets.yaml){ download="homepage-widgets.yaml" }

``` { .yaml .annotate linenums="1" }
- glances:
    url: http://192.168.1.86:61208
    version: 4  # (1)!
    label: truenas1
    cpu: true
    mem: true
    cputemp: true
    uptime: true
    expanded: true

- datetime:
    text_size: xl
    format:
      dateStyle: short
      timeStyle: short
      hour12: false
```

1.  glances on truenas1 is version 4, which serves only `/api/4`, and the widget asks for `/api/3` unless
    it is told the version.
